_comment: One file per class. All classes share the studio05 base body; a class is an animation set plus how our moves map onto its clips. 'animations' is the GLB the clips are read from (same 102-joint rig as the body files), 'clip_marks' its timing marks. weapon_visible/weapon_scale/off_hand: what the hands hold for the look (the combat 'weapon' id keeps owning the stats). Advance (travel) distances live in the weapon's overrides in data/combat/weapons.json.
_weapon_families: Weapon items (catalog weapon_type) this class card may wear in its weapon slot, logic/profile.gd card_can_wear (Boss 2026-11-11) (placeholder: the catalog has only blade weapons; list the class weapon family here once its items exist).
_idle_variants: Idle clips the card portraits (hub cards, character screen) cycle through: mostly states.idle, now and then another one (client/card_portrait.gd). Display only; battle fighters keep states.idle.
_hair_options: Studio 2026-11-11 index.html hair buttons A, B, C, E, F, G (offered for every class); G = hair/hair_g.glb. Each is a hair-only file (art/characters/studio05/split/manifest.json) merged onto the class body.
_pilot: GDD races-and-classes 3.2 pilot profile, read by logic/auto_pilot.gd for squad cards (a class without it keeps the old constants). target: nearest|peel|densest|lowest_hp|marked_first. engage_range 0 = from the weapon; shoot_range 0 = the default 6 m. prefer_marked: attack a target carrying mark_status inside the engage range first (Hunter's Mark focus fire). line is not used yet.
_gauge: GDD races-and-classes 3.10.2: this class's multipliers on the shared race gauge rule (data/races/rules.json gauge, formula 4.7), read by logic/race_passives.gd.
